info.prompt: Cyber-gothic pit where dice nestle in alcoves of fused vertebrae and chrome—hidden pockets glow with "Stashed: 6" tooltips until deployed, their release triggering cascades of synaptic gold dust across a board etched with alchemical equations, while a pressure-slipstream-cruise HUD updates live (75ms/100ms/150ms windows) above players whose avatars fracture into data shards under the weight of leaderboard tension.
